instructions.comment: Accumulator X enters the arithmetic register file.
Accumulator Y enters the arithmetic register file.
Accumulator Z enters the arithmetic register file.
Metadata bit0 marks the neutral lookup entry.
Boundary no-op predicate for the k = 0 lookup entry.
Multi-output streamed tail derives H, A, C, I, K, L, E, F, M, N internally and writes X3, Y3, Z3.

tail_macro.non_clifford_lowering: one G = X + Y field addition, one streamed lookup-(x+y) multiplication for H, two streamed lookup-x multiplications for A and Zx, one C = 21(X + Zx) fixed-chain construction, two streamed lookup-y multiplications for I and yZ, one fused K = H - A - I subtraction, one fused L = 3A double-add, one fixed 21Z multiplication, three internal add/sub kernels, six output multipliers, and three output add/sub kernels

notes: This executable leaf contract keeps lookup x/y as table-fed constants consumed by arithmetic kernels rather than field-sized lookup output wires.
The neutral lookup entry is a boundary no-op: the hot leaf is executed only for nonzero lookup entries, and the boundary keeps the accumulator unchanged for k = 0.

The complete_a0_all_streamed_tail macro is a multi-output lowering of the complete-add tail from three live field values and is counted with all internal G, H, A, Zx, C, I, K, L, yZ, F, E/M/N, product, and output-combine work.
